William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

Gnomic Verses

Soft Snow

IX
I 
WALKÈD
 abroad on a snowy day:
I ask’d the soft Snow with me to play:
She play’d and she melted in all her prime;
And the Winter call’d it a dreadful crime.
